import pytest
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.common.exceptions import NoSuchElementException

@pytest.mark.parametrize("browser", ["Safari", "Google Chrome", "Firefox"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", ["https://hospitalpadmavathi.com/system"])

def test_system_availability(browser, url):
    # Preconditions
    assert browser in ["Safari", "Google Chrome", "Firefox"]
    # Inputs
    driver = webdriver.Firefox() if browser == "Firefox" else webdriver.Chrome(executable_path=webdriver.ChromeBinary().path) if browser == "Google Chrome" else webdriver.Safari()
    # Steps
    driver.get(url)
    try:
        system_url_endpoint = driver.find_element_by_id("system-url-endpoint")
        system_url_endpoint.click()
    except NoSuchElementException:
        pytest.fail(f"System URL endpoint not found on {browser} at {url}")
    # Expected
    assert not driver.current_url == url  # Assuming successful access means moving to the system's URL
